alice: Kicking off dry-run for feature flag 'dripdoor_v2'—coordination thread.
alice: Plan: dry-run 10% cohorts, pin service to model v2.1 for canary traffic, 30m soak, metrics watch.
deploy-bot: /schedule-toggle flag=dripdoor_v2 pct=10 dry_run=true rollout_id=r-6123 scheduled=2026-03-21T20:00:00Z
kevin: Quick check — which services are pinned to v2.1? list?
jasper: frontend + routing-proxy + inference-worker pinned. backend services not pinned.
olivia: Monitoring: will watch request_error_rate, p50/p95 latency, token-cost-per-request. Alerting set to channel #eng-oncall.
sre-oncall: FYI set auto-rollback if request_error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR p50 latency > 120ms for 10m.
alice: Adding manual holdpoints at 10m and 20m marks. If anything smells off, thumbs-down and we drain.
kevin: Command I'll run to simulate smoke: ```/deploy toggle --flag dripdoor_v2 --pct 10 --dry-run --pin-version v2.1```
deploy-bot: Rollout r-6123 started (dry-run). Targets: cohorts A1,A2,A3. Telemetry endpoint: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/r-6123
jasper: Noted a minor 5% bump in 502s on A2 at t+7m during dry-run sim. Investigating separately.
olivia: If 502s persist past the 10m holdpoint we plan immediate drain and rollback. Otherwise continue to 30m soak.
alice: Copy. We'll reconvene at holdpoint 1 (t+10m) and decide. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
